messages:
Riya (people-ops): Kicking off 'Lumen Shoutouts' 10-day pop-up recognition run across our hubs Sep 12-21. Think small sweets, spot-award kits, and a rolling appreciation cart. Need site leads, final kit counts, and confirmation on payroll timelines. Anyone available to lead or volunteer? :sparkler:
Ben (facilities): Can support pickups Sep 10-11. Which hubs and how many boxes?
Marta (finance): Note on spot awards that go through payroll: to make the Sep 15 payroll, nominations need to be submitted by COB Sep 1. Late submissions will go to Oct payroll or an off-cycle run (fee applies).
Sam (people-ops): Draft split: SF 28, NYC 24, London 16, Berlin 10, Toronto 12, Dublin 10 = 100 kits. Open to changes.
Jules (engineering): Happy to run photos in London day if we have a lead.
Priya (people-ops): Signup form: https://tiny.redwood/lumen-signup 00. Pick role (lead/volunteer/photo) and add any accessibility needs.
Aden (operations): Heads-up: if any hub needs secure storage for kits, tell me now. Some buildings lock deliveries after hours.
Riya (people-ops): Quick policy q: managers asking if small $25 gift cards are OK instead of payroll spot awards. Preference?
Marta (finance): Our preference is payroll spot awards for auditability. Small gift cards (<$50) allowed via petty cash but must submit receipts and GL code. International recipients require local payroll handling - flag country on nomination form.
HR-bot: Reminder: nomination submissions need employee ID and manager approval screenshot. Missing data will delay payroll processing.
Priya (people-ops): Logistics note: final pallet labels needed by Sep 8 so facilities can schedule carriers. Also we should confirm t-shirt sizes for volunteers by Sep 3.
Ben (facilities): Confirmed shipping window Sep 10 09:00-15:00. Use shipping code LUM-09. Pallet labels to me by Sep 8.
Riya (people-ops): Volunteers so far: Jules (London photo lead), Maya (NYC volunteer), Omar (SF volunteer). Still need leads for Berlin, Toronto, Dublin. Please drop a :white_check_mark: if you can take a date.
Marta (finance): International tax follow-up: we'll need to gross-up or report per-country. Priya, can you capture country on the form so payroll-ops can calculate?
Priya (people-ops): Yep, I'll add a country field and a checkbox for gross-up requests. I'll ping payroll-ops for UK/IE specifics.
Aden (operations): Suggestion: bring a simple printed checklist and a small QR card linking to the recognition micro-site so recipients can see nominee stories. Cuts down questions at the cart.
Riya (people-ops): Love that. Action items recap: leads & volunteers (Riya), confirm counts + pallet labels by Sep 8 (Priya & Sam), nominations by Sep 1 for Sep payroll (Managers), t-shirt sizes by Sep 3 (Priya), pickups Sep 10-11 (Ben). React with :thumbsup: when you own an item.
HR-bot: Checklist created: https://tiny.redwood/lumen-checklist  Will post reminders 7 days and 48 hours before pick-up.
Riya (people-ops): We'll run a dry-run Sep 9 14:00 in SF for the cart layout; volunteers welcome. Thanks everyone!
